title: SpaceDeployFailedPayload
description: space.deploy.failed v1 (OpenVibe.Space, subject deploy dpl_…, visibility internal): an upload was refused and recorded as a failed deploy with its log, so the owner can see why. Problem codes only, at most ten; never file contents.

site.description: the site name (one DNS label; the site is served at <site>.openvibe.website)

code.description: the refusal problem code (for example deploy.too_large or storage.space_full)

problems.description: the problem codes of the files that were refused
